sources.shortCitation: Grammophon B 51823 / Bestell-Nr. 23042, “Auf Wiederseh’n, Herr Doktor!”
sources.fullCitation: Ben Berlin und sein Orchester, with German refrain vocal. “Auf Wiederseh’n, Herr Doktor!” Fox-trot; label credit “(Rotter-Kaper).” Grammophon, elektrische Aufnahme, Katalog-Nr. B 51823, Bestell-Nr. 23042, side marked 2, label parenthetical “(W. B. W. 2)”, n.d. The uploader names Alexander Fleßburg as the refrain singer and gives 1930 as the recording year; neither is printed on the label. Shellac disc from the Schallarchiv of the Radiomuseum Hardthausen, its label filmed in the YouTube upload.
sources.title: Auf Wiederseh’n, Herr Doktor! — Grammophon B 51823
sources.creator: Ben Berlin und sein Orchester
sources.date: n.d. [recording year given as 1930 by the uploader]

sources.shortCitation: Grammophon B 50959 / Bestell-Nr. 22222, “Nimm diesen Strauß Vergißmeinnicht”
sources.fullCitation: Ben Berlin und sein Orchester. “Nimm diesen Strauß Vergißmeinnicht.” Fox-trot; label credits “(Kaper – Rotter)” and “(Verlag: Roehr A.-G., Berlin)”. Grammophon, elektrische Aufnahme, Serie Polyfar “R” Orchester, Katalog-Nr. B 50959, Bestell-Nr. 22222, side marked 2, n.d. The uploader gives Berlin, 1929 as the recording and first release. Shellac disc from the Schallarchiv of the Radiomuseum Hardthausen, its label filmed in the YouTube upload.
sources.title: Nimm diesen Strauß Vergißmeinnicht — Grammophon B 50959
sources.creator: Ben Berlin und sein Orchester
sources.date: n.d. [recorded and first released in 1929 according to the uploader]
